title: Pager database movement check

scope.rationale: databaseIsUnmoved protects rollback-journal creation and WAL close/checkpoint behavior from operating on a database file that has been renamed or unlinked. It preserves historical compatibility by treating an unsupported SQLITE_FCNTL_HAS_MOVED control as unchanged.
excluded_responsibilities: Rollback-journal file creation after a successful check

external_source_responsibilities: Open database sqlite3_file owns the VFS file-control implementation
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete movement-check body and all active behavior blocks are assigned. Production rollback-journal opening now performs the check before creating or truncating the journal.

inputs: Live Pager with an open database file
outputs: OK, exact VFS file-control error, or SQLITE_READONLY_DBMOVED
contracts.ownership: The Pager and sqlite3_file are borrowed. The movement output is stack-owned scalar storage passed synchronously to the VFS.
contracts.state_and_results: An empty image returns OK without dispatch. SQLITE_NOTFOUND is normalized to OK. SQLITE_OK with nonzero movement returns READONLY_DBMOVED; all other results pass through.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns Pager synchronization. One synchronous xFileControl may inspect filesystem identity; no callback is invoked.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Movement or VFS failure prevents journal opening without mutating transaction ownership. Unsupported controls preserve historical continuation.

representation_differences: The source has an explicit temp-file fast path. Native transient/memory VFS implementations return SQLITE_NOTFOUND for this control, which reaches the same OK result; the explicit empty-image fast path is preserved.
SQLITE_READONLY_DBMOVED is carried as an extended ResultCode value rather than a named enum member.

oracle.protocol: Open a nonempty Pager through an intercepted ABI VFS and return unchanged, moved, arbitrary I/O error, and NOTFOUND outcomes; then set the logical image empty and verify no dispatch-dependent failure.
oracle.normalization: Operation and result codes compare exactly; pointers are identity-only.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: The check is a synchronous VFS identity query. Journal creation remains unstarted on failure; caller owns serialization.
assurance.malformed_input: Null file-control argument cannot arise because Pager supplies stack storage. Nonzero movement values are all treated as moved.
assurance.continuation: NOTFOUND and empty images continue; moved/error outcomes preserve Pager state for rollback or close handling.
assurance.performance: Constant-time fast paths plus one VFS file-control query.

integration.production_owner: src/core/pager.zig Pager and src/core/unix_vfs.zig SQLITE_FCNTL_HAS_MOVED owner
integration.native_call_path: Pager.beginJournal -> Pager.openJournalFile -> Pager.databaseIsUnmoved -> sqlite3_file.xFileControl; Unix VFS compares current file identity and returns the movement scalar.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Rollback-journal opening no longer omits the source movement guard.

independent_review.notes: Requires WAL-close integration, scoped durable trace promotion, and independent review.

known_blockers: Apply the same movement check to source-equivalent WAL close/checkpoint-on-close policy.
Capture a scoped durable journal-open movement receipt before internal-trace promotion.
